news.title: Trump returns to controversial vaccine policy with order questioning childhood schedule

news.title: STAT+: Ban prior auth? And hospitals cut jobs

news.summary: Sanofi is experiencing shortages of two medicines used to treat Pompe disease after the FDA warned the company over manufacturing issues

news.title: STAT+: Sionna’s experimental cystic fibrosis pill falls flat in mid-stage trial
news.summary: A pill from Sionna Therapeutics provided no added benefit when combined with Vertex's cystic fibrosis blockbuster Trikafta, a blow to the biotech.

news.title: STAT+: Heart failure drug from Tenax Therapeutics fails in pivotal study
news.summary: A Tenax Therapeutics drug designed to treat a type of heart failure associated with high blood pressure in the lungs failed in a closely watched study.

news.title: STAT+: Silence Therapeutics aims at Takeda with new data in rare blood cancer
news.summary: A rare blood cancer drug from Silence Therapeutics showed strong results in a trial, potentially setting it up to compete with a Takeda medicine.

news.title: STAT+: China tightens the reins on clinical trials, even as the U.S. looks for ways to replicate its rival’s speed
news.summary: China has tightened regulations on investigator-initiated trials, with consequences not just for Chinese researchers but some Americans, too.

news.title: Opinion: We prepared for Ebola — but not this Ebola
news.summary: “Preparedness cannot mean optimizing every investment for yesterday's epidemic,” write Krutika Kuppalli and Placide Mbala.

news.summary: Despite excitement over the potential of radiopharmaceuticals as cancer treatments, drug developers are hitting new hurdles.

news.title: Opinion: How should states reach out to Medicaid enrollees affected by changes? Our research gives a hint
news.summary: Experts ask: How can we better reach out to people facing Medicaid renewal deadlines and support them through the paperwork requirements?

news.title: STAT+: A shortage of two Sanofi medicines for Pompe disease rattles patients
news.summary: Sanofi is experiencing shortages of two medicines for Pompe disease, alarming patient groups.

news.title: Trump signs executive order to overhaul pediatric vaccine recommendations
news.summary: President Donald Trump signed an executive order Monday that calls for reducing the number of required vaccinations for children in a move that backs a revised immunization schedule pushed by the Department of Health and Human Services.

news.title: Women’s health equity funding hits new high, drawing $1.55B in 2025
news.summary: Women’s health companies raised a record $1.55 billion in disclosed equity in 2025, up 41% year over year. Funding became less concentrated, suggesting capital spread across more companies and categories, according to a new report from W Group.

news.title: The number of health plans reporting operating losses is growing: report
news.summary: Health insurers are under significant financial pressure, and the gap between the organizations that are adapting and those that are not is growing, according to a new report.

news.title: Sanders, Cassidy request DOJ update on contempt status of former Steward Health Care CEO
news.summary: The Senators requested Attorney General Todd Blanche provide an update on the criminal contempt referral against Ralph de la Torre, M.D., by Aug. 20.

news.title: Doximity bets big on hospital adoption of enterprise AI as it ramps up tech spending
news.summary: Doximity's push to be the leading AI digital assistant for docs

news.title: Inside Doctronic’s AI prescription refill pilot program in Utah
news.summary: The company was “very conservative” with the initial formulary, and there are plans to add new medications once it is proven safe to do so, Matt Pavelle, Doctronic co-founder and co-CEO, said.

news.title: Weekly Rundown: Hers rolls out new AI-native app; Novo Nordisk, H1 partner on AI-driven clinical development
news.summary: The latest news from Hims & Hers, Atropos Health, Signal 1, NewYork-Presbyterian, Sharecare, Novo Nordisk, H1, Strida, Hackensack Meridian Health and ModMed.

news.title: Chutes & Ladders— Tufts Medicine CEO, CFO to exit; Jaewon Ryu steps down from Risant
news.summary: Welcome to this week's Chutes & Ladders, our roundup of hirings, firings and retirings throughout the industry. Please submit the good news—or the bad—from your shop, and we will feature it here at the end of each week.

news.title: Insurers see positive results in managing health costs in Q2
news.summary: The health insurance industry weathered a rough 2025, and the turnaround for some companies through the midpoint has surprised even Wall Street analysts.

news.title: Industry Voices—AI won’t fix nurse burnout. Nurses will
news.summary: If AI rollouts follow the path of the technologies that came before them—designed for the system, not the people inside it—they could deepen the very burnout they’re trying to relieve.

news.title: The AI boom could boost Epic's position, health system execs say. Here's where AI startups can still win
news.summary: Clinician-facing AI, imaging AI, patient AI assistants, discharge and care transitions and revenue cycle AI are the categories in which health systems are most willing to look beyond Epic, executives said.

news.title: UPMC, KLAS Research study examines AI adoption trends, governance barriers
news.summary: More than 90% of respondents reported deploying AI tools, but only 44% said they have a dedicated data platform for testing.

news.title: ITM neuroendocrine tumor drug spurned by FDA over manufacturing qualms
news.summary: The FDA has denied ITM Isotopes Technologies’ lead pipeline candidate for a rare group of tumors due to qualms over the drug’s manufacturing.

news.title: MoonLake’s nanobody boosts all clinical endpoints in phase 3 psoriatic arthritis trial
news.summary: MoonLake Immunotherapeutics announced positive phase 3 data for patients with psoriatic arthritis treated with its lead nanobody candidate, sonelokimab.

news.title: Jazz pays $820M to buy Actio, adding clinical-stage asset to orchestra of epilepsy therapies
news.summary: Jazz Pharmaceuticals is adding to its orchestra of epilepsy treatments with the acquisition of Actio Biosciences for $820 million upfront.

news.title: Scholar Rock ditches Novo’s legacy Catalent plant in FDA refiling of SMA drug
news.summary: Scholar Rock has dropped Novo Nordisk’s troubled Catalent facility as a contract manufacturer in its FDA refiling for apitegromab, a spinal muscular atrophy candidate, after a recent inspection of the plant was classified as “Official Action Indicated.”

news.title: Sionna’s cystic fibrosis flop sends stock down 90%, but a ‘significant positive’ for Vertex
news.summary: Sionna Therapeutics has axed a cystic fibrosis add-on program after flunking a phase 2 trial, eliminating a would-be challenger to Vertex Pharmaceuticals’ empire. The biotech plans to “take actions to preserve capital while evaluating next steps.”

news.title: Labcorp nabs FDA green light for BRAF melanoma diagnostic
news.summary: The FDA has signed off on Labcorp’s companion diagnostic for patients with advanced melanoma carrying certain BRAF variants.

news.title: AbCellera women’s health data top ‘most aggressive upside scenario,’ putting Astellas and Bayer on notice
news.summary: AbCellera has reported phase 2 results “beyond even the most aggressive upside scenario” that its CEO dared to consider, boosting the biotech’s chances of challenging Astellas and Bayer for a women’s health market.

news.title: FDA issues alert in wake of BD recall of faulty needle sets that caused 4 deaths
news.summary: The FDA’s Center for Devices and Radiological Health issued an early alert for Becton Dickinson’s Intraosseous Vascular Access system needle sets in the wake of four deaths and 45 serious injuries related to the product.

news.title: Novo Nordisk and Amazon sign AI drug discovery pact, launch London innovation hub
news.summary: Novo Nordisk and Amazon Web Services will partner to leverage AI and accelerate drug discovery.

news.title: Silence brings the noise to Takeda with phase 2 blood cancer win
news.summary: A phase 2 trial of Silence Therapeutics’ divesiran has hit its primary endpoint, emboldening the biotech to gear up for late-phase development of a potential challenger to Takeda and Protagonist Therapeutics’ rusfertide.

news.title: Sobi pens $580M deal for Innate’s skin cancer drug ahead of phase 3 push
news.summary: Sobi has bought into Innate Pharma’s vision for lacutamab, handing the French biotech $75 million upfront for the rights to market the anti-KIR3DL2 antibody for an aggressive skin cancer.

news.title: Arpeggio plays final chord as biotech disbands on poor prospects for Nrf2 program
news.summary: Arpeggio Biosciences’ eight-year song has come to an end, as the transcriptome biotech’s CEO admitted the that company’s Nrf2 program had begun to “unravel.”

papers.title: Towards Interpretable Foundation Models for Retinal Fundus Images
papers.summary: Foundation models are used to extract transferable representations from large amounts of unlabeled data, typically via self-supervised learning (SSL). However, many of these models rely on architectures that offer limited interpretability, a critical issue in high-stakes domains such as medical imaging. We propose DualIFM, a foundation model that is interpretable-by-design via a BagNet backbone whose small receptive fields generate class evidence maps that are faithful to the model's decision-making process. papers.title: The Optimizer Is the Agent: Reasoning-Driven Search across Prompts, Programs, and ML Workflows
papers.summary: Recent systems for optimizing prompts, programs, and ML workflows typically rely on explicit outer-loop controllers such as evolutionary search, bandits, or textual-gradient methods. We ask a fundamentally different question: how much of this search policy can be internalized by a single tool-using agent? We present ReASearch, a unified framework for reasoning-driven optimization in which the agent autonomously decides what to evaluate, how to diagnose failures, which edits to make, and when to verify or restart.
